text:
elaine: Heads up — noticed ~12 users lost product-admin role after last night's Okta mapping change. Happened around 23:40 UTC.

tariq: I saw a spike in 401s from the console too, looks correlated. Any chance the attribute name changed?

elaine: Checking SAML debug logs now. Some assertions missing the 'entitlements' attribute entirely for affected users.

lex: We changed the mapping to prefer `groups` over `entitlements` last deploy. Could be an ordering/override bug. cc @tariq

security-bot: Alert: role_assignment_failures increased by 1200% between 2028-03-12T23:35Z and 2028-03-12T23:50Z

elaine: Pasting the assertion snippet for a single affected user: 
```
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="email">USER@EXAMPLE.COM</Attribute>
  <!-- no entitlements attribute present -->
  <Attribute Name="groups">developers;infra</Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>
```

tariq: Hmm email is uppercase too. We normalize email casing in our SSO handler, but role mapping uses a separate key. Maybe the mapping rule expects lowercase `entitlements` or `entitlements`->`roles` transform.

lex: The PR that rolled this out (deploy-4587) modified the JIT provisioning path to dedupe group->role translations. It may drop an attribute if `groups` present.

elaine: Quick rollback? We can revert mapping change and re-run JIT for affected users. How disruptive is that?

devops-bot: Deploy rollback queued: deploy-4587 -> previous:deploy-4579. ETA ~6m.

tariq: Also raising a short-term patch: tolerantly accept either `entitlements` OR `groups` and prefer explicit mapping table. I'll open a PR to avoid dropping attributes.

lex: Agree. For incident postmortem: we should add an assertion-level audit log for dropped attributes (flag when an attribute present in SAML is ignored by mapping).

elaine: Revert complete. Rollback confirmed by devops-bot at 23:49 UTC. Affected users' roles restored after JIT re-run.

security-bot: Incident created: SSO-1848-role-drop. Severity: medium. Notes: attribute-priority regression, email-case mismatch surfaced.

tariq: I'll follow up with Okta config team to ensure `entitlements` isn't being withheld for certain profiles. Also adding normalization in mapping.

lex: Optional: Add a CI check that simulates assertions with mixed-case emails and missing entitlements. Prevents this regressing.

elaine: Thanks all. I'll draft the postmortem and tag the oncall. :thumbsup:
